assets.prompt: BRINE underwater station-builder scenery sprite. One small waterlogged driftwood fragment lying flat: short irregular forked branch with one broken blunt end, one splintered tapered end, a shallow hollow along the upper surface. Dark desaturated grey-brown soaked wood, softened eroded grain, sparse pale exposed fibres on broken edges, tiny localized olive biofilm. Natural uneven silhouette, no leaves or roots, no regular sawn plank or manufactured fittings. Near-direct overhead orthographic camera, very shallow relief, diffuse neutral lighting, tactile restrained detailed game art. Broad readable wood mass at half a station room canvas width, quiet fine grain instead of high-contrast stripes. Complete object centered diagonally within central 75 percent of square canvas with generous truly transparent RGBA margins; opaque wood surfaces. No sand patch, pedestal, water, cast shadow, rocks, shells, plants, text or glow. Meant as small submerged organic debris below station construction, visually distinct from turquoise industrial wreckage and grey stone.
